title: Lasso Studios
subtitle: Website Design and Development
details:
I worked closely with the owner of Lasso Studios to create a website that serves as a direct showcase of the agency’s work in video, graphic design, and web development.

The layout is visually striking and dynamic, reflecting the creative quality Lasso delivers to its clients. The site functions not only as an effective portfolio but also as a reflection of the studio’s unique approach to design and storytelling.
